name: CUSTODES: AQUILON TERMINATOR SODALITY
description:
Advancing further upon the Cataphractii Terminator armour pattern, Aquilon plate is designed around the Custodes’ enhanced physiques and fitted with additional integrated power systems and capacitors. Aquilon Terminator Sodalities are employed only as absolute need dictates. Often when fighting in close-quarters and 'Zone Mortalis' environs, the Custodes rely on the superior resilience of Aquilon Terminator armour to provide a reliable platform of mobile heavy firepower.

The Emperor’s Finest

This multipart plastic kit builds 6 Aquilon Terminators for Legio Custodes armies in games of Warhammer: The Horus Heresy and Adeptus Custodes armies in Warhammer 40,000. These resplendent golden warriors use their armour’s superior defensive capabilities and deadly advanced weaponry to shrug off the most savage assaults and stand firm while defying the foes of the Imperium.

Reap a Terrible Tally

Each Aquilon Terminator is equipped with 1 Infernus Firepike, 1 Solarite Power Gauntlet, and 1 Misericordia. The kit includes parts to equip every miniature with either Adrathic Combi‑destructors or Lastrum Storm Bolters in place of their Infernus Firepikes, and wielding Solarite Power Talons rather than their Solarite Power Gauntlets.

These miniatures are highly customisable and come with the following interchangeable parts:
– 6 chest plates (of 3 designs)
– 6 helmets (of 3 designs)
– 6 tilting shields (of 3 designs)

Contents:
– 180 plastic components
– 6 Citadel 50mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
